note: Purpose lines for docs/configuration.md (node scripts/gen-config-reference.js --write). vars: one line per environment variable src/ reads; notEnv: ALL_CAPS literals in src/ that are not settings this server reads, with the reason; patterns: names built at run time; defaults: the default the code falls back to where it is not a plain literal at the read site (a named constant, an expression or a branch), each checked against the code. Never a configured value, a rate or a cost. Enforced by scripts/test-config-reference.js.
scope: the server that runs as node src/server.js (every file under src/). The facilitator service (facilitator/), the Cloudflare workers (workers/), the scripts and the published packages are separate programs with their own settings.

The Python MPP SDK sends Accept-Payment from version 0.11.0; a python-httpx client on an earlier version sends X-Payment-Offers: mpp.

vars.OPENFDA_API_KEY: Openfda API key (a credential, set on the host).

vars.OPEN_METEO_READ_CACHE: off reads every forecast, archive and ensemble request upstream; unset keeps each successful read for up to an hour, as each listing says (src/tools/weather-kit.js).

vars.PAYMENT_GUIDE_402: First-contact 402 payment guide block; on unless set to off.
vars.PAYMENT_NETWORKS: Comma list of networks offered in each 402; the primary NETWORK is always first.
vars.PENDING_SETTLE_RECEIPT_WAIT_MS: Pending settle receipt wait, in milliseconds.
vars.PORT: TCP port the server listens on (0 asks the kernel for a free one; the bound port is printed in the listening line).
vars.POSTHOG_AI_EVENTS: PostHog model-call analytics events ($ai_generation); off unless set to on (with POSTHOG_API_KEY). The privacy page describes them only while on.
vars.POSTHOG_AI_HOURLY_MAX: Most PostHog model-call events sent per hour.
vars.POSTHOG_AI_SAMPLE: Share of model calls sent to PostHog, 0 to 1.
vars.POSTHOG_API_KEY: Posthog API key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.POSTHOG_EXCEPTIONS: PostHog error tracking events ($exception); off unless set to on (with POSTHOG_API_KEY). The privacy page describes them only while on.
vars.POSTHOG_EXCEPTION_HOURLY_MAX: Most PostHog error events sent per hour.
vars.POSTHOG_EXCEPTION_SAMPLE: Share of errors sent to PostHog, 0 to 1.
vars.POSTHOG_PROXY_INFLIGHT_STALE_MS: PostHog proxy in-flight entry lifetime, in milliseconds.
vars.POSTHOG_PROXY_MAX_PER_MIN: PostHog proxy requests per minute, per IP.
vars.POSTHOG_PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS: PostHog proxy upstream timeout, in milliseconds.
vars.POW_DIFFICULTY: Proof-of-work difficulty in leading zero bits (8 to 28).
vars.NAMED_AUDIO_MODELS: Comma list of the named speech and transcription model ids to serve beside the default chains, or all (unset: none). Each also needs its cost row, inside the route's margin bound.
vars.POW_SECRET: Stable secret for proof-of-work challenges so they survive restarts (unset: a random secret per process).
vars.PRICE_WEBHOOKS_FILE: File for price webhook registrations, the kept list prices and queued deliveries.
vars.PRICE_WEBHOOK_DELIVERIES: Runtime switch for outbound price webhook deliveries (on; off: registrations and removals keep working and queued deliveries wait).
vars.PRICE_WEBHOOK_DELIVERY_INTERVAL_MS: How often due price webhook deliveries are sent, in milliseconds.
vars.PRICE_WEBHOOK_LIFETIME_DAYS: How long a price webhook registration lasts, in days; registering the same URL again from the same payer renews it.
vars.PRICE_WEBHOOK_MAX: Number of price webhook registrations from which a new one first removes those whose deliveries fail; twice this number is the most the server keeps, and there a new one removes the subscription whose receiver last answered longest ago (a new registration is never refused for room).

Never change it, or POW_SECRET while it is the fallback, once subscriptions exist: every secret and digest changes with it.

vars.RATE_LIMIT_REPLICAS: Number of replicas the per-process rate limits are divided across (default 1).

vars.RECEIPT_SIGNING_KEY: Ed25519 private key (base64 of a PKCS8 PEM) that signs paid-answer receipts; unset leaves receipts off.

vars.RECEIPT_SIGNING_KEY_VALID_FROM: Optional ISO date the key signs from (published as validFrom).

vars.RECEIPT_STORE_PENDING_MAX: Most signed receipts queued while the receipt store cannot take them.

vars.REFERRAL_MAX_VALIDITY_MS: The furthest ahead an authorization may expire.
vars.REFERRAL_MERCHANT_ID: This merchant's id on that contract (a number): a payment counts only when routed to it.
vars.REFERRAL_MIN_NET_BPS: Default:<bps>,<slug>:<bps>: the least share of the price a sale must bring; under it counts toward the slug's stop (unset: 7000 for a model-backed tool, half the expected net for any other).
vars.REFERRAL_OVERSIZE_ALERT: Answers over REFERRAL_MAX_ANSWER_BYTES (413, each an unpaid tool run) from one client address in the unsettled-run window before the status word reads attention; an alarm only, nobody is refused for it.
vars.REFERRAL_OWN_FAULT_COOLDOWN_MS: For this long, answered 503 before the handler; then one call at a time probes, and the hold ends when no refusal has followed for this long plus the time one probe can take.
vars.REFERRAL_OWN_FAULT_MAX: Refusals of this server's own request in a row before calls are held...
vars.REFERRAL_PARITY_GRANDFATHERED: Comma list of slugs served although the public route gives them for less (default: none; each is named in a warning at every boot).
vars.REFERRAL_PAYER_INFLIGHT_MAX: One payer's paid calls in flight before a 429.
vars.REFERRAL_PAYOUT_ADDRESS: The wallet the contract pays this merchant's amount to (0x address).
vars.REFERRAL_PRODUCT_IDS: <slug>:<0x 32-byte id>,...: the product id the split contract's routed event must name for that slug.
vars.REFERRAL_RECEIPT_WAIT_MS: How long a settle success's receipt is read before deciding.
vars.REFERRAL_ROUTED_TOPIC: Topic0 of the split contract's routed-payment event, when it is not the documented one.
vars.REFERRAL_SEND_IDLE_MS: An answer's send with no progress for this long is ended.
vars.REFERRAL_SEND_MAX_MS: An answer's send is ended this long after it began.
vars.REFERRAL_SETTLE_MS: /settle timeout (it waits for the receipt; the facilitator answers within 55 s, and a value under that is a boot warning); a request through the CDN proxy waits less when its verify and run left less before the proxy's answer deadline.
vars.REFERRAL_SETTLE_RESERVE_MS: Validity an authorization must keep after the handler.
vars.REFERRAL_SETUP_URL: The network's setup document (https), echoed in the 402.
vars.REFERRAL_SHORT_NET_MAX: Sales on one slug under that floor before new calls on it answer 503; a model-backed tool stops at one (0: never).
vars.REFERRAL_SIGNER_KEY: Dedicated key that signs referral facilitator requests and holds no funds (a credential, set on the host).
vars.REFERRAL_SLUGS: Comma list of catalog slugs also served under /ref/<slug> (one of the eight settings the referral gate requires).
vars.REFERRAL_STORE_COOLDOWN_MS: A store hold lasts this long (doubling to 10 minutes while failures stay in the window), then a probe write must stand.
vars.REFERRAL_STORE_WINDOW_MS: The window of intent-write failures (refused, or late): two in it hold paid calls before the handler.
vars.REFERRAL_STORE_WRITE_MS: An intent write to the settlement store that has not answered by then is given up (503, nothing settled).
vars.REFERRAL_SWEEP_MS: How often open settlements are read against the chain.
vars.REFERRAL_UNCONFIRMED_MAX: Answers delivered on a success whose receipt is not readable yet; past it they are held.
vars.REFERRAL_UNRECOGNIZED_READS: Full readings of a receipt the proof rule does not recognize before an expired entry is closed to the operator record.
vars.REFERRAL_UNSETTLED_GLOBAL_MAX: Distinct failing payers past which a never-paid wallet is held at one.
vars.REFERRAL_UNSETTLED_HARD_MAX: Unsettled runs that refuse a payer whatever it settled.
vars.REFERRAL_UNSETTLED_MAX: Unsettled runs per payer (over half its outcomes) before a 429...
vars.REFERRAL_VERIFY_SIGNED: Off: send /verify without the signed headers.
vars.RENDER_STATIC_READ: The render tool reads a page's served HTML without the browser when that HTML carries the page's content (src/tools/render-static.js); off sends every page to headless Chromium. Unset = on.
vars.RENDER_WORKER_MIN_ATTEMPT_MS: Render worker minimum attempt, in milliseconds.
vars.RENDER_WORKER_TOKEN: Render worker token (a credential, set on the host).
vars.REPLAY_CLAIM_OP_MS: Bound on each shared-store command of a replay claim the route requires, in milliseconds (5000 when unset, never under SHARED_LIMITS_OP_MS): a store that answers inside it is waited for; past it the call is refused 503 before any payment is taken.
vars.REPUTATION_RECHECK_GLOBAL_HOUR: Seller reputation re-check requests accepted per hour across all callers.
vars.REPUTATION_RECHECK_PER_IP_HOUR: Seller reputation re-check requests one caller may send per hour.
vars.RESEND_API_KEY: Resend API key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.RETURNING_WALLET_DISCOUNT_BPS: Returning-wallet discount in basis points (default 1000; at most 5000).
vars.RETURNING_WALLET_MIN_PAID_DAYS: Distinct paid days a wallet needs inside the window for the returning-wallet price (default 3).
vars.RETURNING_WALLET_PRICE: Set to on to quote a qualifying wallet named in the X-Agent402-Wallet header, and proven in X-Agent402-Wallet-Proof, a lower price on eligible routes' x402 EVM exact accepts (off by default; a proof names the host name of BASE_URL).
vars.RETURNING_WALLET_WINDOW_DAYS: Window, in days, the returning-wallet price counts paid days over (default 30).
vars.ROBINHOOD_MIN_PRICE_USD: Price floor on Robinhood Chain, in USD (unset or 0: none, the list price is quoted).
vars.ROBINHOOD_RELAYER_FIRST_ALERT_HOURS: Robinhood relayer first alert, in hours.
vars.ROBINHOOD_RELAYER_MIN_PRICE_USD: Least sale price, in USD, the own Robinhood relayer settles (0: any).
vars.ROBINHOOD_RELAYER_KEY: Robinhood relayer key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.ROBINHOOD_RELAYER_LOCK_WAIT_MS: Robinhood relayer lock wait, in milliseconds.
vars.ROUTER_WORKERS: Router worker threads (0 or off keeps queries on the serving thread; unset: 1 while the index crawler runs, else 0; at most 4).
vars.ROUTER_WORKER_TEST_WARM_DELAY_MS: Router worker test warm delay, in milliseconds.
vars.ROUTE_INDEX_WARM_DELAY_MS: Route index warm delay, in milliseconds.
vars.RUGCHECK_TOOLS: on lists the Solana token-safety tools and products that depend on that data source.
vars.SANCTIONS_ONE_HOP_DEADLINE_MS: Sanctions one hop deadline, in milliseconds.
vars.SANCTIONS_ONE_HOP_LOOKBACK_MS: Sanctions one hop lookback, in milliseconds.
vars.SANCTIONS_ONE_HOP_MIN_USD: Sanctions one hop minimum, in USD.
vars.SANCTIONS_ONE_HOP_SHARE_FLOOR_USD: Sanctions one hop share floor, in USD.
vars.SANCTIONS_ONE_HOP_TTL_MS: Sanctions one hop lifetime, in milliseconds.
vars.SEARCH_DATA_BACKFILL_CHUNK_DAYS: Search data backfill chunk, in days.
vars.SEI_RELAY_TOKEN: Sei relay token (a credential, set on the host).
vars.SELLER_DELIVERY_FILE: File for the seller delivery outcomes behind seller reputation.
vars.SELLER_REPUTATION: Seller reputation measurement; off turns it off.
vars.SELLER_REPUTATION_FILE: File for the seller reputation records.
vars.SELLER_REPUTATION_FIRST_MS: Delay before the first seller reputation pass after boot, in milliseconds.
vars.SELLER_REPUTATION_FLUSH_MS: How often seller delivery outcomes are written, in milliseconds.
vars.SELLER_REPUTATION_INTERVAL_MS: Interval between seller reputation passes, in milliseconds.
vars.SELLER_REPUTATION_MAX_DELIVERY_ORIGINS: Most seller origins with delivery outcomes kept.
vars.SELLER_REPUTATION_MAX_SELLERS: Most sellers with a reputation record kept.
vars.SELLER_REPUTATION_META_FILE: File for seller reputation re-check requests and the days a crawl cycle failed broadly on our side.
vars.SELLER_REPUTATION_RECHECK_HOST_MS: How long one accepted seller reputation re-check request holds before another is accepted for the same seller, in milliseconds. Default 21600000 (6 hours), at least 1000.
vars.SHARED_LIMITS: off keeps rate-limit counters in process memory even when REDIS_URL is set.
vars.SHARED_LIMITS_DEGRADED_HOLD_MS: Shared limits degraded hold, in milliseconds.
vars.SHARED_LIMITS_PREFIX: Key prefix for shared rate-limit counters, so two deployments on one Redis do not mix.
vars.SHARED_LIMITS_PROBE_FIRST_MS: Shared limits probe first, in milliseconds.
vars.SHED_INFLIGHT: Requests in flight at which load shedding starts.
vars.SHED_LAG_MS: Event-loop lag at which load shedding starts, in milliseconds.
vars.SIGNING_HALTED: Any value other than empty, 0, false, no or off halts every outbound signing path (an emergency lever; read at call time).
vars.SIWE_CHAIN_IDS: Chain ids a wallet sign-in message may name (comma list).
vars.SIWE_SESSION_SECONDS: Wallet sign-in session lifetime, in seconds (at most 3600).
vars.SIWE_SESSION_SECRET: Secret that signs wallet sign-in sessions; set (32 or more characters) turns wallet sign-in on.
vars.SOLANA_FACILITATOR_RECHECK_MS: How often the second Solana facilitator's /supported is read again, in milliseconds. Unset = 10 minutes.
vars.SOLANA_FACILITATOR_SHARE: Percent of Solana quotes that name the second Solana facilitator (integer 0 to 100). Unset = 50.
vars.SOLANA_FACILITATOR_URL: Ordered list of a second Solana mainnet facilitator that takes a share of Solana quotes and settles the payments whose fee payer it names (src/svm-facilitator-split.js). Unset = unchanged.
vars.SOLANA_HISTORY_PUBLIC_MAX_WAIT_MS: Solana history public maximum wait, in milliseconds.
vars.SOLANA_HISTORY_PUBLIC_RPS: Solana history public requests per second.
vars.SOLANA_HISTORY_PUBLIC_TIMEOUT_MS: Solana history public timeout, in milliseconds.
vars.SOLANA_LB_BACKFILL_TX_PER_CYCLE: Solana lb backfill transaction per cycle.
vars.SOLANA_LB_NO_ACCOUNT_RECHECK_MS: Solana lb no account recheck, in milliseconds.
vars.SOLANA_LB_RETRY_PAUSE_MS: Solana lb retry pause, in milliseconds.
vars.SOLANA_UPSTREAM_BUYER_KEY: Private key of the Solana spending wallet route-execute buys with (a credential, set on the host).
vars.SOLANA_UPSTREAM_BUYER_LOW_USD: Solana upstream buyer low, in USD.
vars.SOLANA_WALLET_ADDRESS: Solana address that receives USDC; without it the Solana option is left out of every 402.
vars.SOLVADOR_KEY: Solvador key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.SOR_BASE_UNPROVEN_DAILY_USD: Router base unproven daily, in USD.
vars.SOR_BASE_UNPROVEN_MAX_USD: Router base unproven maximum, in USD.
vars.SOR_BASE_UNPROVEN_SELLER_DAILY_USD: Router base unproven seller daily, in USD.
vars.SOR_CHAIN_REFUSAL_WINDOW_MS: Router chain refusal window, in milliseconds.
vars.SOR_EVM_UNPROVEN_CHAINS: EVM chains other than Base on which the router tries a seller below the settlement floor under the unproven ceiling (comma separated names or CAIP-2 ids; unset = Base only).
vars.SOR_EVM_UNPROVEN_MAX_USD: Router unproven ceiling per call on the chains SOR_EVM_UNPROVEN_CHAINS lists, in USD (default 0.01; 0 or off switches them off).
vars.SOR_REFUSAL_MAX_WAIT_MS: Router refusal maximum wait, in milliseconds.
vars.SOR_SELF_FUNDING_CLEARED_FILE: Router self funding cleared file path.
vars.SOR_SELLER_DELIVERY_FAIL_TTL_MS: Router seller delivery fail lifetime, in milliseconds.
vars.SOR_SELLER_REFUSAL_TTL_MS: Router seller refusal lifetime, in milliseconds.
vars.SOR_SVM_PROOF_TTL_MS: Router Solana proof lifetime, in milliseconds.
vars.SOR_SVM_UNPROVEN_MAX_USD: Router Solana unproven maximum, in USD.
vars.SOR_WALLET_DAILY_MAX_USD: Router wallet daily maximum, in USD.
vars.SQL_CERT_SIGNING_KEY: SQL cert signing key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.SQL_QUERY_STATS_FLUSH_MS: SQL query stats flush, in milliseconds.
vars.SQL_QUERY_STATS_KEEP_DAYS: SQL query stats keep, in days.
vars.STATE_DATABASE_URL: Postgres connection string for the state database (stores, leases, journals); unset uses files under the data root.
vars.STATE_DB_CONNECT_TIMEOUT_MS: State database connect timeout, in milliseconds.
vars.STATE_DB_IDLE_TX_TIMEOUT_MS: State database idle transaction timeout, in milliseconds.
vars.STATE_DB_LARGE_ROW_MAX_MS: State database large row maximum, in milliseconds.
vars.STATE_DB_LEASE_ACQUIRE_MS: State database lease acquire, in milliseconds.
vars.STATE_DB_LEASE_FAILOPEN_MS: State database lease failopen, in milliseconds.
vars.STATE_DB_MS_PER_MB: State database per MB, in milliseconds.
vars.STATE_DB_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS: State database query timeout, in milliseconds.
vars.STATE_DB_RECOVERY_PROBE_MS: State database recovery probe, in milliseconds.
vars.STATE_DB_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_MS: State database statement timeout, in milliseconds.
vars.STATE_STORE_RETRY_MAX_MS: State store retry maximum, in milliseconds.
vars.STATUS_PROBE_TOKEN: Status probe token (a credential, set on the host).
vars.STELLAR_FACILITATOR_KEY: Stellar facilitator key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.STELLAR_FACILITATOR_STATUS_TIMEOUT_MS: Stellar facilitator status timeout, in milliseconds.
vars.STELLAR_FALLBACK_FACILITATOR_KEY: Stellar fallback facilitator key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.STELLAR_WALLET_ADDRESS: Stellar address that receives USDC on the Stellar rail.
vars.STOCK_DATA_PROVIDER: Stock data provider behind stock-quote and stock-history (off lists none of them).
vars.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: Turns on card checkout, monitors and the card wire (a credential, set on the host).
vars.STRIPE_SHADOW_SENDING_STALE_MS: Stripe shadow sending stale, in milliseconds.
vars.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: Verifies Stripe webhook signatures (a credential, set on the host).
vars.SVM_FUNDING_RETRY_AFTER_S: Solana funding retry after, in seconds.
vars.TELEMETRY_ID_SECRET: Telemetry id secret (a credential, set on the host).
vars.TEMPO_ACCESS_KEY_CHECK_TIMEOUT_MS: Tempo access key check timeout, in milliseconds.
vars.TEMPO_API_KEY: Turns on the Tempo rail (a credential, set on the host).
vars.TEMPO_DATA_API_KEY: Tempo data API key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.TEMPO_LATE_CONFIRM_DELAYS_MS: Tempo late confirm delays, in milliseconds.
vars.TEMPO_RELAY_VALIDATE_TIMEOUT_MS: Tempo relay validate timeout, in milliseconds.
vars.TEMPO_SUBSCRIPTION_FEE_PAYER_KEY: Tempo subscription fee payer key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.TEMPO_SUBSCRIPTION_FEE_PAYER_LOW_USD: Tempo subscription fee payer low, in USD.
vars.TEMPO_SUBSCRIPTION_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS: Tempo subscription RPC endpoint timeout, in milliseconds.
vars.TEMPO_SUBSCRIPTION_VALID_FOR_S: Tempo subscription valid for, in seconds.
vars.TEMPO_UPSTREAM_BUYER_KEY: Private key of the Tempo spending wallet route-execute buys with (a credential, set on the host).
vars.TEMPO_UPSTREAM_BUYER_LOW_USD: Tempo upstream buyer low, in USD.
vars.TOOL_ANSWER_SAME_WINDOW_H: Tool answer same window, in hours.
vars.TOOL_FAILURE_REPLICA_STALE_MS: Tool failure replica stale, in milliseconds.
vars.TOOL_RELIABILITY_PUBLIC: Per-tool reliability table on /api/reliability/tools; off (or 0, false, no) withdraws it: the route answers available:false and every surface that points to it drops the pointer. Unset = on.
vars.TOP_BUYER_FAIL_HOLD_MS: Top buyer fail hold, in milliseconds.
vars.TOP_BUYER_FAIL_WINDOW_MS: Top buyer fail window, in milliseconds.
vars.TRANSCRIBE_LONG: Set to on to list and serve the thirty-minute transcription tier (/api/transcribe-long).
vars.TRUST_PROXY_HOPS: Number of reverse proxies that append X-Forwarded-For; 0 ignores the header.
vars.TWEET_QUEUE: The approved post queue as JSON; the server posts one per clock hour from it (off unless set).
vars.TWEET_QUEUE_FIRST_TICK_MS: Tweet queue first tick, in milliseconds.
vars.TWEET_QUEUE_POSTING: off keeps the post queue read-only.
vars.TWITTER_ACCESS_SECRET: Twitter access secret (a credential, set on the host).
vars.TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN: Twitter access token (a credential, set on the host).
vars.TWITTER_API_KEY: Twitter API key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.TWITTER_API_SECRET: Twitter API secret (a credential, set on the host).
vars.TYPESAFE_API_KEY: Typesafe API key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.UPSTREAM_BUYER_DROP_TOLERANCE_USD: Upstream buyer drop tolerance, in USD.
vars.UPSTREAM_BUYER_TREND_FILE: Unset with no state database: process memory (a restart forgets the trend).
vars.UPSTREAM_COSTS_FILE: Path to the private upstream cost table, read when UPSTREAM_COSTS_JSON is unset.
vars.UPSTREAM_COSTS_JSON: The private upstream cost table as JSON (never committed; see docs/example-upstream-costs.json for its shape).
vars.WALLET_ADDRESS: EVM address that receives payments (payTo on Base and the other EVM rails). Required unless FREE_MODE is true.
vars.WARPCAST_API_KEY: Warpcast API key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.WEB_BOT_AUTH: Web Bot Auth signature verification on requests (on).
vars.WISH_FIND_MISS_MAX_PER_HOUR: Wish find miss maximum per hour.
vars.X402_BATCH_CLAIM_INTERVAL_SECONDS: Interval between x402 payment channel claim passes, in seconds.
vars.X402_BATCH_IDLE_REFUND_SECONDS: Idle time after which an x402 payment channel's balance is refunded, in seconds.
vars.X402_BATCH_REFUND_INTERVAL_SECONDS: Interval between x402 payment channel refund passes, in seconds.
vars.X402_BATCH_SETTLEMENT_NETWORKS: Networks offering x402 payment channels (comma list of CAIP-2 ids); unset, empty, 0, false, off or no turns them off, and an entry that is not a CAIP-2 id is ignored.
vars.X402_BATCH_SETTLEMENT_STORE: Store for x402 payment channel state; memory names the single-process store.
vars.X402_INDEX_CRAWL: on crawls the external seller index regardless of environment detection; off stops it.
vars.X402_PAYWALL_FAILED_RECHECK_HOURS: X402 paywall failed recheck, in hours.
vars.X402_RAIL_RECHECK_MAX_MS: X402 rail recheck maximum, in milliseconds.
vars.X402_UPSTREAM_BUYER_KEY: Private key of the Base spending wallet route-execute buys with (a credential, set on the host).
vars.X_ACCESS_SECRET: X access secret (a credential, set on the host).
vars.X_ACCESS_TOKEN: X access token (a credential, set on the host).
vars.X_API_KEY: X API key (a credential, set on the host).
vars.X_API_SECRET: X API secret (a credential, set on the host).
vars.X_BEARER_TOKEN: Read token for the X data tools (a credential, set on the host).
vars.X_DATA_DAILY_HARD_MAX_USD: X data daily hard maximum, in USD.
vars.X_DATA_DAILY_MAX_USD: X data daily maximum, in USD.
vars.X_SEARCH_STATS_FLUSH_MS: X search stats flush, in milliseconds.
vars.ZEPTOMAIL_TOKEN: Zeptomail token (a credential, set on the host).
vars.CHARGED_FAILURE_ALARM_HOURS: Hours a paid call that settled and then answered an error keeps the chargedFailures status word on recent. Unset = 6.
vars.GLAMA_MAINTAINER_EMAIL: Maintainer address published in /.well-known/glama.json (a fork sets its own).
vars.REFUND_OWED_ALARM_HOURS: Hours a refund may stay owed before the refundsOwed status word reads aging. Unset = 48.
vars.REFUND_OWED_NOTICE_MINUTES: Minutes a refund may stay owed before the refundsOwed status word reads owed. Unset = 15.
vars.SOLANA_ACTIVITY_COLD_FAST_READS: Transaction reads at the start of a never-read Solana wallet's activity scan that do not queue for the public history lane. Unset = 40; 0 queues every read.
vars.SOLANA_ACTIVITY_FILE: File holding the Solana activity scans' state without a state database (default /data/solana-activity.json, the temp directory without a volume).
vars.SOLANA_ACTIVITY_PUBLIC_WAIT_MS: Longest a Solana activity scan's read queues for the public history lane before the keyed lane is tried under the background share, in milliseconds. Unset = 10000.
vars.SOLANA_ACTIVITY_SCAN_BUDGET_MS: Clock for one Solana activity scan, which runs behind the page, in milliseconds. Unset = 120000.
vars.SOLANA_ACTIVITY_STORE: off keeps the Solana activity scans' state in memory only (a restart reads each wallet's window again). Unset = stored.
vars.SOLANA_ACTIVITY_STORE_FLUSH_MS: How often waiting Solana activity scan states are written to the store, a bounded number a tick, in milliseconds. Unset = 60000.
vars.SOLANA_ACTIVITY_STORE_MAX_WALLETS: Wallets whose Solana activity scan state is kept; the least recently written are dropped first. Unset = 500, at most 5000.
vars.SOLANA_ACTIVITY_STUCK_SCANS: Scans in a row a transaction read may fail before the Solana activity scan skips and counts it. Unset = 3.
vars.SOLANA_HISTORY_BACKGROUND_KEYED_DAILY_MA: Keyed-lane Solana history reads a day for readers nobody is waiting on, the activity scans and the Solana board (unset: a twentieth of HARDCAP_ALCHEMY_CALLS; never over half of it; 0 = public lanes only). Past it those views serve what they hold with its age.
vars.SOLANA_HISTORY_BACKGROUND_MAX_WAIT_MS: Longest a background Solana history read queues for the public lane before the keyed lane is tried under the background share, in milliseconds. Unset = 30000.
vars.SOLANA_LB_TX_CONCURRENCY: Transaction reads in flight per payTo in a Solana board scan (1 to 32). Unset = 2, which keeps the paced public lane's queue short for other readers.
vars.UPSTREAM_BUDGET_SYNC_MS: How often each process adds its calls to the upstream budgets' shared day counters and reads the totals back, in milliseconds. Unset = 15000.
vars.UPSTREAM_CALL_DAYS_FILE: File holding the per-caller daily call counts without a state database (default /data/upstream-call-days.json, the temp directory without a volume).
vars.UPSTREAM_CALL_DAYS_FLUSH_MS: How often the per-caller daily call counts are folded into their document, in milliseconds. Unset = 60000.
